module: Helper for presenting the cargo screen (delivery): prepares for the UI the filters (parcel, vehicle, trailer, material, all, loaner), the groupings (by type, destination, player container, task) and the sorts of cargo/offer "cards". Called by career_modules_delivery_cargoScreen; does not modify the game, it annotates the card tables (groupTags, filterTags, sortValues).
notes: The filters are built lazily (ensureFilterTags) with translated labels; onLanguageChanged resets them.
Locking: the 'trailer' filter requires level 3 and 'material' level 5 of the 'logistics-delivery' branch.
Each filter counts facilityCards and playerCards (reset to zero by resetFilterCounters, incremented by getCardGroupSetsByKey with usePlayerCards false).
Probable bug: in getFilterSets, 'filter.order = i' uses an undefined variable i (the loop is 'for _, filter'), so order is nil.

Inconsistency: in the 'distance' sort, the fallback test compares a.weight/b.weight instead of the distances; the comments say 'high to low' for rewardMoney and weight while the comparators sort in ascending order.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook: stores the delivery modules (parcelManager, cargoScreen, general, generator, progress, vehicleOfferManager, parcelMods, vehicleTasks, tutorial).

onLanguageChanged.desc: Hook: clears the cached filters to regenerate the labels in the new language.

resetFilterCounters.desc: Resets the facilityCards and playerCards counters of all filters to 0 and rebuilds their key index.

getCardGroupSetsByKey.desc: Builds the grouping sets ('ungrouped', by cargo type, by destination, by player container/storage, by task): fills card.groupTags and card.filterTags for each card, creates the groups with their list of card ids and their filterTags, and updates the filter counters.

cardsById.desc: Cards (parcelGroup, storage, vehicleOffer, loaner) keyed by id.

usePlayerCards.desc: true: only process the player's cards; false: those of the facility.

playerCargoContainers.desc: Player containers (see career_modules_delivery_general.getNearbyVehicleCargoContainers), used for the container groups and total storage.

returns.desc: Grouping sets by key, each with key, label and groups.

getCardSortingSetsByKey.desc: Computes sort ranks (card.sortValues) for cardId, rewardMoney, weight, distance and availablilty (order: limit, no more room, locked, tutorial, expired) and returns the description of the sorts.

addSortingValuesToGroups.desc: Gives each group sortValues (cardId, rewardMoney, weight, distance) equal to the minimum of the values of its cards.

getFilterSets.desc: Returns the list of filters for the UI: hasAvailableOffers if cards exist, lockedInfo (minimum logistics-delivery level for 'trailer' and 'material') and order.

addFilterPlayerData.desc: Sets filter.noContainers for the 'parcel', 'material' and 'all' filters when the player has no suitable container (parcel, fluid, dryBulk).

getConfirmButtonFromPlayerCards.desc: Counts the items to confirm (player cards with transient moves or spawnWhenCommitingCargo; a non-material parcelGroup counts as #ids) for the UI confirmation button.
